p6/esc1121:1.speaker: seeker
p6/esc1121:1.text: Hi, I am having a really hard time. I just found out that my boyfriend cheated on me a year ago.

p6/esc1121:10.speaker: seeker
p6/esc1121:10.text: I am thinking that you are right. I feel like my whole world is upside down and I have wasted all this time with the wrong guy and the wrong best friend. I also wonder who else he might have cheated on my with.

p6/esc1121:11.speaker: supporter
p6/esc1121:11.text: Yeah, that might be true, a relationship isn't healthy if you are cheated on

p6/esc1121:12.speaker: seeker
p6/esc1121:12.text: I am so grossed out because I am a germaphobe to begin with. I have not slept with any other person in my whole life so I feel like I am ruined. I want to throw up when I think of him cheating on me. I want to get married and I have a timeline so I am also really confused on what to do if I dump him.

p6/esc1121:13.speaker: supporter
p6/esc1121:13.text: To dump him is the best thing to do in my opinion. But always go where your heart is, because you won't be happy if you don't. If you do though, there are plenty men out there, and one of them is chasing you

p6/esc1121:14.speaker: seeker
p6/esc1121:14.text: Yeah, the guy who liked me was super rich too! My boyfriend is telling me that he wants my best friend to still be in the wedding party too. She was suppose to be my maid of honor, no less.

p6/esc1121:15.speaker: supporter
p6/esc1121:15.text: Yeah, but don't go with him because of he money though, genuinely get to know him first

p6/esc1121:16.speaker: seeker
p6/esc1121:16.text: I have compartmentalized my life and never thought of looking around at my other options. You are making really good points. I need to just stop and really look at my options. I never realized that I have options, it's not like i am even engaged yet.

p6/esc1121:17.speaker: supporter
p6/esc1121:17.text: Yeah, you have a lot of options at this stage, so always do what your heart is telling you at the end of the day

p6/esc1121:18.speaker: seeker
p6/esc1121:18.text: It feels good sharing how I feel with you because you don't have a dog in the fight so to speak.

p6/esc1121:19.speaker: supporter
p6/esc1121:19.text: yeah, lool something like that ;). Glad your better

p6/esc1121:2.speaker: supporter
p6/esc1121:2.text: Have you confronted him about it yet?

p6/esc1121:20.speaker: seeker
p6/esc1121:20.text: I never listen to my heart and think that is a great place to start. I always have a plan and go with that but you are making a lot of sense. Thank you for your time today.

p6/esc1121:22.speaker: seeker
p6/esc1121:22.text: Have a great day and I might be back soon to give an update.

p6/esc1121:3.speaker: seeker
p6/esc1121:3.text: Yes, I told him that my best friend confessed it to me. It was my best friend and him. I was so shocked.

p6/esc1121:5.speaker: seeker
p6/esc1121:5.text: No, I am so mad but I don't want to break up with him. I told my best friends that I never want to see her again though. My boyfriend and I have plans to get engaged this month. I am furious at him though.

p6/esc1121:6.speaker: supporter
p6/esc1121:6.text: I think you should postpone the engagement as infidelity during marriage is far more painful

p6/esc1121:7.speaker: supporter
p6/esc1121:7.text: You are strong if you are able to forgive him though because I know I wouldn't

p6/esc1121:8.speaker: seeker
p6/esc1121:8.text: I have never been so blind sided. Maybe I should reconsider! I have had a guy after me for at least the last year but I never cheated! I really wanted to though.

p6/esc1121:9.speaker: supporter
p6/esc1121:9.text: No you should never cheat, because you would be on the same wavelength as your boyfriend. Instead, if you like the other man then you should go where your feelings take you :)

p6/esc140:0.speaker: supporter
p6/esc140:0.text: Hello! How are you doing today?

p6/esc140:10.speaker: seeker
p6/esc140:10.text: Yeah, I just do not know what to do

p6/esc140:11.speaker: supporter
p6/esc140:11.text: Do you mind me asking what the argument was about? If you don't mind going into a little more detail, I may be able to help you more.

p6/esc140:12.speaker: seeker
p6/esc140:12.text: I was sick and he did not call me all day to even check in on me. I told him that I was upset about that.

p6/esc140:13.speaker: supporter
p6/esc140:13.text: That must be such a terrible feeling. So the argument started because you were sick, he didn't check in on you at all for that entire day, and when you expressed your feelings to him, it turned into an argument?

p6/esc140:14.speaker: supporter
p6/esc140:14.text: Has he ever acted this way towards you before? For example, has he ever shown a lack of empathy towards you like this in the past?

p6/esc140:16.speaker: supporter
p6/esc140:16.text: Have you tried reaching out to him throughout the course of these past two weeks to see if he would respond?

p6/esc140:17.speaker: supporter
p6/esc140:17.text: I would really like to help you find a solution to this problem, but it appears as though you may not be active anymore. I'm going to wait a few more minute for you to respond before cancelling the chat. In the event that I don't hear back from you, I wish you the best!

p6/esc140:3.speaker: seeker
p6/esc140:3.text: I am really a little upset.

p6/esc140:4.speaker: supporter
p6/esc140:4.text: I'm so sorry to hear that. What's going on that's making you feel that way?

p6/esc140:5.speaker: seeker
p6/esc140:5.text: Me and my partner had an argument and I got ghosted after. It's been 2 weeks.

p6/esc140:6.speaker: supporter
p6/esc140:6.text: That's terrible. So you had an argument and he hasn't spoken to you in two weeks. Is that correct?

p6/esc140:8.speaker: supporter
p6/esc140:8.text: I can imagine that you must be really hurt amongst a number of other feelings. Hearing you tell me that he has done this is upsetting to me as well.

p6/esc140:9.speaker: supporter
p6/esc140:9.text: I've had the same thing done to me and I can remember being extremely distraught.

p6/esc660:0.speaker: seeker
p6/esc660:0.text: I am worried about being perfect on my job.  I don't want to lose my job.

p6/esc660:1.speaker: supporter
p6/esc660:1.text: I hear you are trying to be perfect on your job because you are worried about losing your job.  How long have you been at your job?

p6/esc660:10.speaker: seeker
p6/esc660:10.text: I will have to try that.  That might help.

p6/esc660:11.speaker: supporter
p6/esc660:11.text: Have you thought of doing additional work related trainings?  Sometimes they can give suggestions to improve work abilities.

p6/esc660:12.speaker: seeker
p6/esc660:12.text: That sounds great.  Do you think my work would be supportive?

p6/esc660:13.speaker: supporter
p6/esc660:13.text: Work can often pay for trainings or offer suggestions what may improve work strategies.

p6/esc660:14.speaker: seeker
p6/esc660:14.text: Wow, I hope I can take advantage of that.  I will have to check into that.  Who should I approach at work?

p6/esc660:15.speaker: supporter
p6/esc660:15.text: You could ask your immediate supervisor or sometimes Human resources for support.

p6/esc660:16.speaker: seeker
p6/esc660:16.text: I can do that.  I think I'll reach out tomorrow to Human Resources for some help.

p6/esc660:17.speaker: supporter
p6/esc660:17.text: That sounds like a good plan to reach out for support.  Is there anything else I can help with?

p6/esc660:18.speaker: seeker
p6/esc660:18.text: No that should be all.  I am feeling more confident in strategies to use to help me.  Thanks

p6/esc660:2.speaker: seeker
p6/esc660:2.text: I have been working for about 4 months, but I just am not as fast at it as everyone else.  I'm trying so hard working late and everything but it's never enough.

p6/esc660:3.speaker: supporter
p6/esc660:3.text: That can be hard when you are working so hard to try to do your best.  Can you consult with a supervisor or co-workers to get some help?

p6/esc660:4.speaker: seeker
p6/esc660:4.text: Maybe I could ask my friend and co-worker for some tips.  I'm a little embarrassed to do so, but don't know where to turn. I don't want to get fired.

p6/esc660:5.speaker: supporter
p6/esc660:5.text: Asking for help isn't always a bad thing.  I asked for help at my last job and they gave me someone to help out.  I was so relieved.

p6/esc660:6.speaker: seeker
p6/esc660:6.text: That's true maybe it could turn out for the better.  But what if they see me as incompetant?

p6/esc660:7.speaker: supporter
p6/esc660:7.text: I can see that you have worry of being seen incompetent but as long as you are doing your best, they have to see the efforts you are making as positive.

p6/esc660:8.speaker: seeker
p6/esc660:8.text: That's a good way to put it.

p6/esc660:9.speaker: supporter
p6/esc660:9.text: Sometimes deep breaths can help keep you calm when approaching others in an anxiety provoking situation.

p6/esc717:10.speaker: supporter
p6/esc717:10.text: There are counselors out there to help with relationships.

p6/esc717:11.speaker: seeker
p6/esc717:11.text: That sounds like something I could try.

p6/esc717:12.speaker: supporter
p6/esc717:12.text: Do you have any family supports?

p6/esc717:13.speaker: seeker
p6/esc717:13.text: My sister has been through a similar situation and perhaps could help.

p6/esc717:14.speaker: supporter
p6/esc717:14.text: It sounds like your sister could be a great support being that she has had a similar situation.

p6/esc717:16.speaker: supporter
p6/esc717:16.text: Family can often be a strength for support.

p6/esc717:17.speaker: seeker
p6/esc717:17.text: That is so true.  Thanks so much.  I'm going to get some help and am feeling better about things.

p6/esc717:18.speaker: supporter
p6/esc717:18.text: Yes, family can be a great support.  I am glad you are starting to move forward with a plan.

p6/esc717:19.speaker: seeker
p6/esc717:19.text: Have a great night.  Thanks again.

p6/esc717:2.speaker: supporter
p6/esc717:2.text: I see you aren't feeling so well.  What seems to be going on?

p6/esc717:20.speaker: supporter
p6/esc717:20.text: Thank you for chatting and I wish you well.

p6/esc717:21.speaker: seeker
p6/esc717:21.text: I feel so much calmer now after chatting with you.

p6/esc717:3.speaker: seeker
p6/esc717:3.text: I'm really anxious over a breakup.

p6/esc717:4.speaker: supporter
p6/esc717:4.text: I'm sorry to hear that you are experiencing a breakup.  That's really hard.

p6/esc717:5.speaker: seeker
p6/esc717:5.text: I'm not sure where to go or what to do?

p6/esc717:6.speaker: supporter
p6/esc717:6.text: Just from chatting with you, I can see how anxious you are in trying to get a path forward..

p6/esc717:7.speaker: seeker
p6/esc717:7.text: I don't know how to be alone.

p6/esc717:8.speaker: supporter
p6/esc717:8.text: That's really hard, but there are supports out there.

p6/esc717:9.speaker: seeker
p6/esc717:9.text: Where can I go for support?

p6/esc858:0.speaker: seeker
p6/esc858:0.text: My friend Lisa borrowed money from me but she won't return it now

p6/esc858:1.speaker: supporter
p6/esc858:1.text: I am sorry about that. It is always hard when we trust someone and they let us down. is that waht you are feeling? Disappointment in your friend?

p6/esc858:10.speaker: seeker
p6/esc858:10.text: Yes,she just sounded non-comittal,saying that she will return it when she can

p6/esc858:11.speaker: supporter
p6/esc858:11.text: I see. It is a financially difficult time for us all. I am wondering if your friend might be upset and embarrassed that they can not pay you back immediately? Have you asked her if she could even afford some sort of small payments?

p6/esc858:12.speaker: seeker
p6/esc858:12.text: Yes,i asked her how we could restructure the payment in her favor because i understand how difficult it is for everyone right now but she did not answer

p6/esc858:13.speaker: supporter
p6/esc858:13.text: Were you speaking on the phone or in person? Is this a financial burden for you?

p6/esc858:14.speaker: supporter
p6/esc858:14.text: Would you consider this person a good friend? Would you be sad if they were not in your life anymore?

p6/esc858:15.speaker: seeker
p6/esc858:15.text: We were speaking on phone because i wanted to set up a physical meeting where we could discuss the logistics

p6/esc858:16.speaker: seeker
p6/esc858:16.text: Yes,it is a financial burden because this is money i was saving for a venture

p6/esc858:17.speaker: supporter
p6/esc858:17.text: That is very difficult. It is hard to judge things on the phone.

p6/esc858:18.speaker: seeker
p6/esc858:18.text: Yes,this is a really close friend from way back and i would be devastated to lose the friendship

p6/esc858:19.speaker: seeker
p6/esc858:19.text: It is difficult to judge on the phone yes,which is why i wanted a physical meeting but she snapped at me and said that she will just pay me when she can

p6/esc858:2.speaker: seeker
p6/esc858:2.text: Yes,i am very dissapointed because i trusted her completely.

p6/esc858:20.speaker: supporter
p6/esc858:20.text: I see. I am very sorry about that! it is very difficult when a friend betrays your trust like that.

p6/esc858:22.speaker: supporter
p6/esc858:22.text: It sounds like you are doing what you can. It is very nice of you to have been this patient.

p6/esc858:23.speaker: seeker
p6/esc858:23.text: How do you suggest i shoulp proceed?

p6/esc858:24.speaker: supporter
p6/esc858:24.text: Is the friendship more important than the money? That is what it came down to for me.

p6/esc858:26.speaker: supporter
p6/esc858:26.text: If you can not get her to meet with you, perhaps it might be time to seek advice from a lawyer? That is providing that you are willing to possibly lose a friend.

p6/esc858:27.speaker: seeker
p6/esc858:27.text: Thank you very much for the advice

p6/esc858:28.speaker: supporter
p6/esc858:28.text: you are welcome. Good luck! I hope you find resolution and find a way to save your friendship!

p6/esc858:3.speaker: supporter
p6/esc858:3.text: I understand. I have been through a similar situation.

p6/esc858:4.speaker: supporter
p6/esc858:4.text: Was it a large amount of money?

p6/esc858:5.speaker: seeker
p6/esc858:5.text: What did you do to come out of the tricky situation?

p6/esc858:6.speaker: seeker
p6/esc858:6.text: Yes,it was for me,a total of $10000

p6/esc858:7.speaker: supporter
p6/esc858:7.text: Oh, That is a very large amount of money. I can understand your being upset with them

p6/esc858:8.speaker: supporter
p6/esc858:8.text: Have you talked to them about the money and returning it?

p6/esc858:9.speaker: seeker
p6/esc858:9.text: Yes,i am very very upset.What would you do in my position?

p6/p6_conv_10:0.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_10:0.text: Hey, feeling a bit all over the place today. Mind if I share?

p6/p6_conv_10:1.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_10:1.text: Of course, Jane. I'm here to listen. What's been going on?

p6/p6_conv_10:10.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_10:10.text: I feel closer to her actually. We both admitted how much the wedding planning has stressed us out.

p6/p6_conv_10:11.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_10:11.text: That’s insightful. Acknowledging shared stress can bring people together. How’s the wedding planning going now?

p6/p6_conv_10:12.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_10:12.text: Better. We’ve agreed to communicate openly about decisions. It feels more like a partnership now, rather than me just helping her.

p6/p6_conv_10:13.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_10:13.text: That’s great to hear, Jane. Open communication is key in any relationship.

p6/p6_conv_10:14.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_10:14.text: Yeah, I've also started journaling again. It helps sort through these complicated feelings.

p6/p6_conv_10:15.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_10:15.text: Journaling is a great tool. How does writing about your thoughts and emotions help you?

p6/p6_conv_10:16.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_10:16.text: It gives me clarity. Putting pen to paper makes everything feel less overwhelming and more manageable.

p6/p6_conv_10:17.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_10:17.text: I’m glad it’s helping you. Have you noticed any other changes since you reconciled with Eliza?

p6/p6_conv_10:18.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_10:18.text: I feel a bit lighter emotionally. Mending the rift with her feels like a burden lifted.

p6/p6_conv_10:19.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_10:19.text: That’s a beautiful way to put it. Rebuilding that connection must feel rewarding.

p6/p6_conv_10:2.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_10:2.text: Well, you know how Eliza and I had that big fight about her wedding?

p6/p6_conv_10:20.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_10:20.text: It does. I’m also trying to be more proactive about addressing my financial stress instead of letting it control me.

p6/p6_conv_10:21.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_10:21.text: That’s a positive step forward. You've been through a lot, and it’s important to take care of yourself too.

p6/p6_conv_10:22.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_10:22.text: Trying my best. It’s a work in progress, you know? Balancing everything is tough.

p6/p6_conv_10:23.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_10:23.text: Absolutely. You’re making great progress, even if it doesn’t always feel that way. I’m here whenever you need to talk.

p6/p6_conv_10:24.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_10:24.text: Thank you, that means a lot. I’ll keep leaning on you if that's okay.

p6/p6_conv_10:25.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_10:25.text: Always, Jane. Your journey is important, and I’m here to support you along the way.

p6/p6_conv_10:3.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_10:3.text: Yes, you’ve mentioned feeling misunderstood during that time. How are things between you two now?

p6/p6_conv_10:4.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_10:4.text: We actually had a really deep conversation a few days ago. Lots of tears but good ones, I think.

p6/p6_conv_10:5.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_10:5.text: That sounds intense but potentially healing. How did that feel for you?

p6/p6_conv_10:6.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_10:6.text: It was a mix of relief and lingering sadness. I’m happy we cleared the air, but all those pent-up emotions were exhausting.

p6/p6_conv_10:7.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_10:7.text: It makes sense to feel drained after such a heart-to-heart. It's brave of you both to confront those emotions together.

p6/p6_conv_10:8.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_10:8.text: Thanks. I just wish it didn't have to get so messy before getting better.

p6/p6_conv_10:9.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_10:9.text: Relationships can be messy, but the reconciling part is important. How’s your perspective on everything now?

p6/p6_conv_11:0.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_11:0.text: Hey there, do you have a moment to chat?

p6/p6_conv_11:1.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_11:1.text: Of course, Jane. What's on your mind?

p6/p6_conv_11:2.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_11:2.text: I attended a social event recently, and it unearthed some emotions I thought I had tucked away.

p6/p6_conv_11:3.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_11:3.text: It sounds like it was quite an experience. What happened that brought these feelings to the surface?

p6/p6_conv_11:4.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_11:4.text: I met someone there who reminded me of my past relationships, particularly the one that ended in a mess due to infidelity.

p6/p6_conv_11:5.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_11:5.text: That must have been tough to be reminded of. How did it feel encountering someone who brought those memories back?

p6/p6_conv_11:6.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_11:6.text: It was like reliving a bit of that heartache. I was both fascinated and apprehensive.

p6/p6_conv_1:0.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_1:0.text: Hey Jane, how have you been holding up lately?

p6/p6_conv_1:1.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_1:1.text: Hi. Not too great, to be honest. It's been a rough couple of weeks.

p6/p6_conv_1:10.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_1:10.text: It sounds like you're mourning the loss of that friendship. Have you had a chance to reach out or communicate with her recently?

p6/p6_conv_1:11.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_1:11.text: I’ve tried. Sent a couple of messages, but they’ve gone unanswered.

p6/p6_conv_1:12.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_1:12.text: It must feel really disappointing not to hear back. What do you miss most about your friendship with Lisa?

p6/p6_conv_1:13.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_1:13.text: We used to bounce ideas off each other, and she was the first person I'd call when something great happened at work.

p6/p6_conv_1:14.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_1:14.text: It's understandable to miss those shared moments and support. How are you managing everything else alongside this?

p6/p6_conv_1:15.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_1:15.text: It's made focusing on work tough. I feel a bit isolated, honestly.

p6/p6_conv_1:16.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_1:16.text: I'm so sorry you're feeling this way. Feeling isolated can really weigh on you. Is there anyone else you feel comfortable confiding in?

p6/p6_conv_1:17.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_1:17.text: I haven't really opened up to anyone else about this. It's been hard admitting to myself how deep this issue has affected me.

p6/p6_conv_1:18.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_1:18.text: It takes a lot of courage to open up. It's important to take time for yourself and process everything. Is there anything you can do to help ease your mind a bit right now?

p6/p6_conv_1:19.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_1:19.text: Maybe get back into some hobbies. I used to enjoy painting but haven't done it in a while.

p6/p6_conv_1:2.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_1:2.text: I'm really sorry to hear that. Would you like to talk about what's been going on?

p6/p6_conv_1:20.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_1:20.text: That sounds like a wonderful idea. Engaging in something creative can be really therapeutic. Would you like support picking it back up?

p6/p6_conv_1:21.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_1:21.text: I think that would help. Just getting started again might lift this weight a little.

p6/p6_conv_1:22.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_1:22.text: I'm here to support you with this. Whenever you're ready, you can share your progress, and I’d love to hear how it goes.

p6/p6_conv_1:23.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_1:23.text: Thank you. It feels a bit better knowing someone’s there to listen. I appreciate it.

p6/p6_conv_1:24.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_1:24.text: Anytime, Jane. You’re not alone in this. We'll take it one step at a time.

p6/p6_conv_1:3.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_1:3.text: Well, do you remember Lisa? My friend I mentioned before?

p6/p6_conv_1:4.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_1:4.text: Yes, I remember you talking about them. What's up with Lisa?

p6/p6_conv_1:5.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_1:5.text: So, we've hit this weird and stressful snag. I lent her some money months ago and she hasn’t paid me back yet.

p6/p6_conv_1:6.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_1:6.text: That definitely sounds stressful. How is it affecting your relationship with Lisa?

p6/p6_conv_1:7.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_1:7.text: She's completely cut off communication with me. No calls, texts, nothing.

p6/p6_conv_1:8.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_1:8.text: That must be really hard on you, especially since she was such a close friend.

p6/p6_conv_1:9.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_1:9.text: It feels like losing a part of my life. We used to hang out all the time and now it's just silence.

p6/p6_conv_2:0.speaker: seeker

p6/p6_conv_8:17.text: I think that could be really beneficial. You're taking important steps by recognizing where you are. You're not alone in this.

p6/p6_conv_8:18.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_8:18.text: Thanks, I appreciate that. Just expressing these feelings openly has been a relief.

p6/p6_conv_8:19.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_8:19.text: I'm glad to hear that. I'm always here to listen. Take care of yourself, Jane.

p6/p6_conv_8:2.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_8:2.text: My sister Eliza just announced her engagement.

p6/p6_conv_8:3.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_8:3.text: Oh wow, that must be a big piece of news for the family. How are you processing it?

p6/p6_conv_8:4.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_8:4.text: I'm happy for her, truly, but it also makes me reflect on where I am in my life.

p6/p6_conv_8:5.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_8:5.text: It's completely natural to have mixed feelings. Have you been able to talk to Eliza about how you're feeling?

p6/p6_conv_8:6.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_8:6.text: Not yet. I don’t want to dampen her excitement with my own worries.

p6/p6_conv_8:7.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_8:7.text: That's considerate of you. How has this news been affecting you emotionally?

p6/p6_conv_8:8.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_8:8.text: I feel lonely, to be honest. Recently, things haven't been great for me...work stress, financial issues...it's cumulative.

p6/p6_conv_8:9.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_8:9.text: That sounds really challenging. You've been through a lot lately. Remember, it's okay to feel this way.

p6/p6_conv_9:0.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_9:0.text: Hi Jane, how are you holding up lately?

p6/p6_conv_9:1.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_9:1.text: Hey, not the best to be honest. Things aren't getting any better.

p6/p6_conv_9:10.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_9:10.text: Remember, it's not always easy to navigate these situations. Has this tension changed how you feel about attending the wedding?

p6/p6_conv_9:11.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_9:11.text: A bit, yeah. I was looking forward to being part of it, but now it feels awkward.

p6/p6_conv_9:12.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_9:12.text: It's understandable to feel conflicted. Being part of her big day is important, but so is your peace of mind.

p6/p6_conv_9:13.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_9:13.text: Exactly. I just worry that our relationship might not be the same after this.

p6/p6_conv_9:14.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_9:14.text: Are there moments from the past where you've overcome conflicts together?

p6/p6_conv_9:15.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_9:15.text: Yes, there were times we've disagreed but always managed to mend things eventually.

p6/p6_conv_9:16.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_9:16.text: That's promising. Perhaps this can be mended over time too. Do you think talking to her calmly might help?

p6/p6_conv_9:17.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_9:17.text: Maybe. I guess I need to find the right time and words to explain my intentions.

p6/p6_conv_9:18.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_9:18.text: That sounds like a thoughtful approach. Taking time to sort out your feelings first could also be beneficial.

p6/p6_conv_9:19.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_9:19.text: Yes, I think writing about it in my journal could help me process everything.

p6/p6_conv_9:2.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_9:2.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you want to talk about what's been going on?

p6/p6_conv_9:20.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_9:20.text: That's a great idea, Jane. The journal seems like a good outlet for you.

p6/p6_conv_9:21.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_9:21.text: Thanks. It always helps me get things off my chest and see things more clearly.

p6/p6_conv_9:22.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_9:22.text: You have a lot on your plate right now, but I'm confident you'll find a way to navigate through it.

p6/p6_conv_9:23.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_9:23.text: I hope so. Thanks for listening. It makes a difference knowing someone understands.

p6/p6_conv_9:24.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_9:24.text: I'm always here for you, Jane. Whenever you need someone to talk to, just reach out.

p6/p6_conv_9:25.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_9:25.text: I really appreciate that. Talk to you soon.

p6/p6_conv_9:26.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_9:26.text: Take care. Remember to be gentle with yourself.

p6/p6_conv_9:3.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_9:3.text: It's mostly about my sister, Eliza. We had a huge argument while planning her wedding.

p6/p6_conv_9:4.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_9:4.text: I'm really sorry to hear that. It can be tough when someone close to you is involved. What happened?

p6/p6_conv_9:5.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_9:5.text: She just doesn't appreciate my suggestions. I was only trying to help, but she took it the wrong way.

p6/p6_conv_9:6.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_9:6.text: That sounds frustrating, especially when you're just trying to be helpful. How did she react?

p6/p6_conv_9:7.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_9:7.text: She accused me of trying to control everything and said I wasn't being supportive.

p6/p6_conv_9:8.speaker: supporter
p6/p6_conv_9:8.text: It must be really hurtful to feel misunderstood like that. How are you feeling about it now?

p6/p6_conv_9:9.speaker: seeker
p6/p6_conv_9:9.text: I feel terrible. I love her and want to be there for her, but now it seems I've done the opposite.

6d9e30288c0c2b1550d0f8879165be8ff1b98de1.head: MP
6d9e30288c0c2b1550d0f8879165be8ff1b98de1.statement: has reconciled with sister Eliza after a conflict related to her wedding planning

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: We actually had a really deep conversation a few days ago. Lots of tears but good ones, I think.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: It was a mix of relief and lingering sadness. I’m happy we cleared the air, but all those pent-up emotions were exhausting.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: I feel closer to her actually. We both admitted how much the wedding planning has stressed us out.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Better. We’ve agreed to communicate openly about decisions. It feels more like a partnership now, rather than me just helping her.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: I feel a bit lighter emotionally. Mending the rift with her feels like a burden lifted.

b8913e51426cbc0ab8bba6789a097bf3f95dffa2.head: MP
b8913e51426cbc0ab8bba6789a097bf3f95dffa2.statement: working at a job for about 4 months with recent performance concerns

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Yeah, I thought it might help calm my anxieties. But with my job performance not being where it's supposed to be, and money problems, I just feel stuck.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: I am so grossed out because I am a germaphobe to begin with. I have not slept with any other person in my whole life so I feel like I am ruined. I want to throw up when I think of him cheating on me. I want to get married and I have a timeline so I am also really confused on what to do if I dump him.

4980bffa965d1b663fa47b4fb8b4618c9bce6360.head: MP
4980bffa965d1b663fa47b4fb8b4618c9bce6360.statement: experiencing financial burden due to car repair costs on top of unresolved lent money affecting savings for a venture

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: It really is. I've been trying to manage, but the financial stress keeps piling up. I still haven't resolved the money issue with my friend, and now this... It's overwhelming.

0ae726996f3a6dd989864af7d1b59dbe16e463e1.head: ME
0ae726996f3a6dd989864af7d1b59dbe16e463e1.statement: seeker shared feelings of isolation and loss in conversation with supporter

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: It's made focusing on work tough. I feel a bit isolated, honestly.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: I haven't really opened up to anyone else about this. It's been hard admitting to myself how deep this issue has affected me.

f8113e1ad9d2ff84f31ffbab6b53e6fec7939196.head: ME
f8113e1ad9d2ff84f31ffbab6b53e6fec7939196.statement: seeker found emotional relief in talking to neutral supporter about relationship crisis

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: It feels good sharing how I feel with you because you don't have a dog in the fight so to speak.

67c4fca0c42c0aec529a3e9ea5524ecdb70c2fa5.head: ME
67c4fca0c42c0aec529a3e9ea5524ecdb70c2fa5.statement: seeker began questioning engagement plans after realizing depth of betrayal

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: I am thinking that you are right. I feel like my whole world is upside down and I have wasted all this time with the wrong guy and the wrong best friend. I also wonder who else he might have cheated on my with.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: I am so grossed out because I am a germaphobe to begin with. I have not slept with any other person in my whole life so I feel like I am ruined. I want to throw up when I think of him cheating on me. I want to get married and I have a timeline so I am also really confused on what to do if I dump him.

1b0184f66953a24a7c45921f29bf4e4e72bc34aa.head: ME
1b0184f66953a24a7c45921f29bf4e4e72bc34aa.statement: felt relief and increased clarity after voicing struggles around work, finances, and friendship loss to a supportive listener

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: I’ll try to keep that in mind. Just voicing it all out helps me see things a bit clearer.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Thank you so much. Having someone listen without judgment really makes a difference.
